Record a trip

Every trip, with the details you’ll want next time.

Pick the water and start. Add the rest as you go, or when you get home.

The water
The lake, river, or reservoir, with every trip you have taken there.
Date and time
When you went and how long you stayed.
Catches and species
Each fish with its species, its length, and whether you kept it.
Tackle and gear
The lure, bait, or technique for a catch, and the setup you brought.
Weather
Sky and air temperature from Apple Weather, where you logged it.
Notes and photos

Blank days count too. Log the trip even if nothing bit.

See the fishing journal

What worked last time?

You caught them here last May. On what?

Look back at the waters you’ve fished, the species you’ve caught, and the tackle recorded with those catches.

  • Where you catch themEleven Mile Reservoir, 28. Clear Creek, 7. Blue River, 5.
  • What they takePanther Martin, 17 fish. Olive Woolly Bugger, 10. Nightcrawler, 7.
  • Your bestsLongest 19.0 inches. First caught April 13, 2024.

These are your own catches, counted. No forecasts and no recommendations. In Trips, you can also search by water, species, person, or lure.

See recaps and books

Keepsake PDF

Turn the season into a book.

Choose the trips and photographs you want to include. Cast Your Line puts them into a keepsake PDF you can save or print.

  1. Choose a recap or a keepsake.
  2. Pick the outings and the photos.
  3. Choose a page size: 8 or 10 inch square, Letter, or A4.
  4. Export the PDF.

The app creates the PDF. Printing is up to you: at home, or through any print service.

Private by design

Your spots stay yours.

A fishing journal does not need an audience. Nothing you record is posted anywhere.

How privacy works

  • No account required
  • No feed, followers, or leaderboards
  • Your records are private to you
  • Works offline
  • Syncs through your own iCloud
  • No ads and no tracking
